description:
Battistics Remote is the iPhone companion to Battistics, the free Mac app. It needs a Mac running Battistics, signed in to iCloud with the same Apple Account.

See your Macs at a glance: charge, time left, power, battery health, heat and whether the lid is closed. Start Keep Awake for a set time or until you turn it off, add time, or stop it.

- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, including one for every Mac
- A Lock Screen and Dynamic Island countdown with Add Time and Stop
- A Control Center and Action Button control
- Siri and Shortcuts actions that can name the Mac they act on
- Alerts when a session ends, the battery runs low, the Mac runs hot or it charges to a level you pick

Everything goes through your private iCloud database. Nothing reaches the developer, and there is nothing to pair.

To look around before you set up a Mac, tap Try a Sample Mac on the first screen.
promotionalText: See your Mac's battery and keep it awake from your iPhone, through your own iCloud. No account, no server.
whatsNew:
Keep Awake stays quiet while your Mac is working. Delayed background updates no longer trigger premature “no word from the Mac” alerts.

Fixed
- Fewer repeated battery, heat and connection warnings during the same session.
- The Lock Screen activity stays visible when a status update is delayed, with a clear indication of when the Mac last updated.
- Turning notifications off clears previously scheduled alerts immediately.
- Normal task completion and healthy connection changes no longer interrupt you.

Battery and heat protections remain active. Update Battistics on your Mac too for the complete notification improvements.
